Lena: VelocityFin procurement needs a one-pager acceptance + cost delta (reserved vs burst) for their SRE review. Can we finalize today?
Arun: Proposed POC targets from them: p95 <240ms, p99 <580ms at 240 QPS. I suggest we set p95 <300ms and p99 <750ms to avoid noisy neighbor fails.
Beth: Traffic mix i'll use: 62% short-gen (~30 tokens), 28% long-gen (~160 tokens), 10% embed. Will push k6 scripts to the poc bucket.
Arun: Run config: KV cache ON, batching=7, prewarm 10m, pin model rwd-serve-2.1.
Lena: Security asks: IP allowlist, KMS note, 90d audit retention, signed test consent. SecTeam, confirm copy?
SecTeam: Copy: "Hosted supports KMS connector for customer keys; Private supports CMK. Audit logs retained 90 days by default." Posted to /shared/pocs/velocityfin/sec.txt.
Beth: Runbook:
1) smoke 10 QPS x 3m
2) ramp 10->240 QPS over 12m
3) steady 240 QPS x 30m
4) burst 480 QPS x 90s x2
k6 command:
```
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 32m velocity_mix.js
```
PerfBot: Enable detailed traces for ramp+steady; capture kv_hit, tokens/sec, GPU util, 5xx.
Arun: Quick internal baseline: p95=175ms p99=420ms @130 QPS, batch=7 on an A100-eq. dev numbers only.
Lena: Pricing roughs: reserved pool for 240 QPS ~= $22.5k/mo; burst cushion to 480 QPS amortized ~= +$4.6k/mo. Final depends on avg tokens.
Beth: Proposed acceptance criteria for VelocityFin:
- Sustain 240 QPS for 30m with success rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 300ms, p99 < 750ms
- No unexpected 5xx during steady window; graceful degradation tested during burst
Lena: I'll send the one-pager + IP CIDR request. Once they ack, we'll book a 2hr window and tag ops. :thumbsup:
